about: Meals, snacks and exercises added to the built-in plan builder's library after it shipped, in the same shape as library.json and exercises.json (dishes only use ingredients from library.json; the app works out their nutrition, tags and cost). Families' servers download this every 2 weeks. New entries arrive by pull request (tools/library-pr.sh).

dishes.name: Chicken, pumpkin and chickpea tray bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the pumpkin into 3 cm pieces and the onion into wedges. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Toss everything except the lemon with the oil, salt, pepper and a teaspoon of ground cumin or paprika on a big tray.
Sit the chicken on top and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the pumpkin is soft.
Squeeze the lemon over before serving.
dishes.kid: Serve the chicken, pumpkin and chickpeas in separate piles; leave the lemon off.

dishes.name: Tuna and sweet potato patties with salad
steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato. Microwave it covered with a splash of water for 8 to 10 minutes until soft, then mash.
Mix in the drained tuna, the egg and the sliced spring onion. Shape into patties about 2 cm thick.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with the salad leaves and a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.kid: Make small patties; they're good cold in a lunchbox.

dishes.name: Chicken and corn noodle soup
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer with the grated ginger.
Slice the chicken thinly, add it and simmer for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the noodles and corn and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
Season with the soy sauce and scatter the sliced spring onion on top.
dishes.kid: Lift the noodles, chicken and corn out with a slotted spoon if they'd rather not have soup.

dishes.name: Pork and broccoli rice noodles
steps: Soak or cook the rice noodles as the packet says, then drain.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and stir-fry it in half the oil with a splash of water for 3 minutes. Set aside.
Brown the pork mince with the crushed garlic in the rest of the oil, breaking it up.
Push the pork aside, scramble the egg in the gap, then add the noodles, broccoli and soy sauce and toss until hot.
dishes.kid: Keep some plain noodles and pork aside before adding the soy sauce.

dishes.name: Ricotta and berry toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Warm the berries in the microwave for 40 seconds so they're soft and juicy.
Spread the ricotta on the toast, spoon the berries over and drizzle with the honey.
dishes.kid: Serve the berries in a little bowl for dipping.

dishes.name: Couscous salad with chickpeas and feta
steps: Pour the same amount of boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Dice the cucumber and tomato. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Toss everything with the crumbled feta, lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper.

dishes.name: Cheese and mushroom omelette with toast
steps: Slice the mushrooms and soften them in half the butter in a small frying pan for 3 minutes. Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then tip it all onto a plate.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt the rest of the butter in the pan over medium heat and pour the eggs in.
Gently pull the set edges into the middle a few times. When the top is nearly set, spoon the mushrooms, spinach and grated cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette in half, slide it onto the plate and serve with the toast.
dishes.kid: Leave the filling on the side if they'd rather have a plain omelette.

dishes.name: French toast with berries and yoghurt
steps: Whisk the egg and milk in a shallow dish with a pinch of cinnamon if you have some.
Soak each slice of bread in the mixture for a few seconds a side.
Fry in the butter over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Warm the berries in the microwave for 1 minute and spoon them over with the yoghurt.
dishes.kid: Cut into fingers for dipping in the yoghurt.

dishes.name: Crustless ham and spinach quiche
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a small baking dish (or a muffin tray for mini ones).
Chop the onion finely, the ham into small pieces and the spinach roughly.
Whisk the eggs and milk, then stir in the onion, ham, spinach and half the grated cheese. Pour into the dish and scatter the rest of the cheese on top.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes (15 to 18 for mini ones) until set in the middle. Serve warm or cold with the salad leaves.
dishes.kid: Mini ones from a muffin tray fit well in a lunchbox.

dishes.name: Croque monsieur with side salad
steps: Make a sandwich with the ham and half the grated cheese between the two slices of bread.
Butter the outsides lightly and cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down gently, until golden and melty.
Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top for the last minute with a lid on, so it melts.
Serve with the salad leaves and sliced tomato.
dishes.kid: Cut into triangles; serve the tomato on the side.

dishes.name: Tuna niçoise salad
steps: Cut the potato into chunks and boil for 12 minutes. Add the trimmed beans and the egg for the last 7 minutes.
Drain, cool the egg in cold water, then peel and quarter it.
Arrange the torn lettuce, potato, beans, tomato wedges, egg and drained tuna on a plate.
Whisk the oil and lemon juice with a pinch of salt and pour it over just before eating.
dishes.kid: Keep everything in separate piles and leave off the dressing.

dishes.name: Lentil and vegetable soup with bread
steps: Dice the onion, carrot, celery and potato, and crush the garlic.
Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil in a big pot for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, potato and stock. Simmer with the lid partly on for 20 to 25 minutes, until the lentils fall apart.
Season, blend part of it if you like it thicker, and serve with the bread.
dishes.kid: Blend it smooth if lumps are a problem.

dishes.name: Chicken ratatouille with potatoes
steps: Cut the chicken, zucchini and capsicum into bite-sized pieces, slice the onion and crush the garlic. Cut the potatoes into chunks.
Brown the chicken in half the oil in a large pan, then set it aside.
Cook the onion, capsicum and zucchini in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, tomatoes, a pinch of dried herbs and the chicken.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, and serve together.
dishes.kid: Serve the potatoes plain beside a small spoon of the stew.

dishes.name: Creamy chicken and mushroom fricassee with rice
steps: Start the rice cooking. Cut the chicken into strips, slice the mushrooms and chop the onion.
Brown the chicken in the oil, then add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 8 minutes, then stir in the cream and let it bubble gently until it thickens a little.
Steam or boil the beans for 4 minutes and serve everything with the rice.
dishes.kid: Serve the chicken with a little sauce, and the rice and beans on the side.

dishes.name: Salmon parcels with lemon, potatoes and beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into small chunks, toss with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Lay each piece of salmon on a sheet of baking paper with thin slices of zucchini, the beans, a slice of lemon, the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt.
Fold the paper into a sealed parcel and put the parcels on the tray with the potatoes.
Bake for 15 minutes more, until the salmon flakes easily. Open the parcels at the table.
dishes.kid: Flake the salmon and check for bones before serving.

dishes.name: Slow-cooker beef and mushroom bourguignon
steps: In the morning, cut the beef into large chunks, the carrot into thick slices and the onion into wedges. Halve the mushrooms.
Put everything except the potatoes, butter and milk into the slow cooker with the crushed garlic, tomato paste, stock and a bay leaf if you have one. Cook on low for 8 hours.
Before dinner, boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the butter and milk.
Serve the beef and its sauce over the mash.
dishes.kid: Cut the beef small and serve the mash on the side.

exercises.name: Band calf raise
exercises.how: Loop the band under the balls of your feet and hold the ends at your shoulders. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly. Hold a wall if you need to.

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
exercises.how: A dumbbell in each hand by your sides. Rise up onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg press calf raise
exercises.how: On the leg press, the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the plate and legs straight but not locked. Push through your toes, then let your heels back slowly.

exercises.name: Band side steps
exercises.how: Band just above your knees, knees slightly bent. Take small steps sideways keeping the band tight, then step back the other way.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg press
exercises.how: On the leg press with a light weight, one foot in the middle of the plate. Lower until your knee is at about a right angle, then press away without locking the knee.

exercises.name: Cable biceps curl
exercises.how: Facing a low cable with a straight bar, elbows by your sides. Curl the bar up to your chest, then lower it slowly.
